import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD1 = 998244353L;
    static final long MOD2 = 1000000007L;
    static final long BASE = 1000000L;

    static int n, total, result;
    static int[] sumArr = new int[15];
    static List<Long>[] buckets = new ArrayList[15];

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
            buckets[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static void generate(int depth, long num) {
        if (depth == 7) return;
        total++;
        long val = ((total - num) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1;
        buckets[depth].add(val);
        sumArr[depth] = (int)((sumArr[depth] + val) % MOD2);
        for (int d = 0; d <= 9; d++) {
            generate(depth + 1, num * 10 + d);
        }
    }

    static void process(long x) {
        if (x > n) return;
        if (x * BASE + BASE - 1 <= n && x * BASE * 10 > n) {
            long currentTotal = total;
            for (int i = 0, mul = 1; i <= 6; i++, mul *= 10) {
                int size = buckets[i].size();
                long diffVal = ((currentTotal - x * mul) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1;
                int pos = lowerBound(buckets[i], (MOD1 - diffVal));
                result = (int)((result + diffVal * size + sumArr[i]) % MOD2);
                long subtractVal = ((long)MOD1 * (size - pos)) % MOD2;
                result = (int)((result - subtractVal + MOD2) % MOD2);
                total += size;
            }
            return;
        }
        total++;
        long addVal = ((total - x) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1;
        result = (int)((result + addVal) % MOD2);
        for (int d = 0; d <= 9; d++) {
            process(x * 10 + d);
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, long key) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= key) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        generate(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 7; i++) {
            Collections.sort(buckets[i]);
        }
        total = 0;
        result = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 9; i++) {
            process(i);
        }
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
